result.summary: Cross-checked all 14 ACs for REQ-201 against test/letflow/obs/alerts_test.exs. Found 2 genuine coverage gaps and 1 cosmetic defect; all three fixed. All 17 tests pass. Spec at test/specs/REQ-201.md.

gaps_found_and_fixed.description: DLQ depth hook must NOT re-fire on subsequent evaluations while above threshold; AC requires ≥3 evaluation cycles.
gaps_found_and_fixed.prior_state: Test ran exactly 2 above-threshold cycles (fire + one no-fire). A bug that re-fired on the 3rd+ cycle would have been undetected.
gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Added a 3rd above-threshold run_detection call (dlq_count: 20) with refute_receive, satisfying the ≥3 cycle requirement.

gaps_found_and_fixed.description: After retry exhaustion, exactly ONE error must be logged. 'log =~ ...' only asserts presence, not count.
gaps_found_and_fixed.prior_state: assert log =~ "alert delivery exhausted" passes even if multiple exhaustion log lines are emitted.
gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed to Regex.scan/2 count assertion: exhaustion_count = length(Regex.scan(~r/alert delivery exhausted/, log)); assert exhaustion_count == 1.

gaps_found_and_fixed.description: Second test in the AC-11 describe block was a verbatim duplicate of the first, with a misleading description claiming to check the Application children list.
gaps_found_and_fixed.prior_state: Both tests called refute function_exported?(Alerts, :start_link, 1) and :child_spec. Second test provided zero additional coverage.
gaps_found_and_fixed.fix: Replaced duplicate with a source-assertion test: reads lib/letflow/application.ex and asserts the string 'Letflow.Obs.Alerts' is absent — matching AC-11's own 'confirmed by git diff of application.ex' wording.
